briefing.headline: Soft landing intact as inflation eases and growth steadies, though sentiment has weakened.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 sits near the Fed's target, letting rate cuts proceed.
Unemployment at 4.2 percent for Sep 2026 remains low, anchoring household spending despite softer sentiment.

briefing.whats_new: Today: Brent crude fell sharply from 123.10 USD to 107.03 USD, easing energy inflation pressure.
